strategy.description: Reuse tokens already present in the base tokenizer. Do not resize the vocabulary during the first SFT pilots.
strategy.confidence_policy: Confidence and verification are computed by validators and critics, not self-reported by the student.
strategy.entropy_policy: Simulated entropy markers are forbidden for deterministic business annotation.

activation_gates_for_any_new_marker: The marker has one unambiguous semantic function.
The marker costs at most two tokens in every finalist tokenizer.
